LanguageData.VTE_AirDuct.description: A sealed utility duct that moves conditioned air between the control unit, compressors, and room units. It can route an Appalachia Freeze network through several compartments without occupying the rooms themselves.
LanguageData.VTE_VentValve.description: A manually switched valve for opening or isolating one branch of an air-conditioning network. Useful for separating damaged, unused, or differently conditioned rooms.
LanguageData.VTE_UndergroundAirDuct.description: A reinforced air duct buried beneath the floor. It carries conditioned air between network devices while remaining protected from gunfire and normal foot traffic.
LanguageData.VTE_ACControlUnit.description: An Appalachia Freeze environmental control station. It sets the target temperature for every linked room unit and coordinates the compressor load; overloaded networks consume more power until additional compressors are connected.
LanguageData.VTE_ACUnit.description: An Appalachia Freeze climate unit fitted into a wall. It supplies warm or cold air according to the network setting and must be connected to a control unit through air ducts.
LanguageData.VTE_ACUnitWall.description: A compact Appalachia Freeze climate unit mounted against a wall. It supplies warm or cold air according to the network setting and must be connected to a control unit through air ducts.
LanguageData.VTE_ACCompressor.description: An outdoor Appalachia Freeze compressor that circulates refrigerant for a connected climate-control network. While powered, it supports two additional room units without reducing network efficiency.
LanguageData.VTE_LargeACCompressor.description: A heavy outdoor Appalachia Freeze compressor for large climate-control networks. While powered, it supports six additional room units without reducing network efficiency.
LanguageData.VTE_IndustrialCooler.description: A large Appalachia Freeze wall cooler for serious refrigeration and industrial climate control. Cold air exits one side while hot exhaust is dumped out the other.
LanguageData.VTE_IndustrialHeater.description: A large Wattz industrial heater that fits into a wall and pushes serious utility heat. It can automatically cycle to a target temperature.
LanguageData.VTE_LargeCeilingFan.description: A large Wattz ceiling fan for workshops, warehouses, and other rooms that need stronger air circulation.
LanguageData.VTE_SmallCeilingFan.description: A Wattz ceiling fan for slow, steady air circulation in smaller rooms.
LanguageData.VTE_StandingCooler.description: A freestanding Appalachia Freeze cooling unit for open rooms that need relief from summer heat without full freezer performance.
LanguageData.VTE_WallHeater.description: A Wattz wall heater that fits into a wall and keeps rooms warm without wasting floor space.
LanguageData.VTE_WallMountedCooler.description: An Appalachia Freeze wall-mounted cooler for compact freezer rooms and tight utility spaces.
LanguageData.VTE_WallMountedHeater.description: A compact Wattz wall-mounted heater for utility corridors, workshops, and smaller rooms that still need dependable automatic temperature control.
LanguageData.VTE_WallMountedVent.description: A simple Wattz wall vent for equalizing temperatures between adjacent rooms without opening a passageway.
